scope: Explicit exact, unfiltered resident, ascending squared-distance TopK, dimension 128, K in [1,32], and the existing fanout policy must already be enabled. Unsupported FP state retains the existing path.
change: Keep K+1 stable query-local slots with certified intervals. Disjoint intervals determine canonical distance order; overlapping intervals materialize the integer ExactSum. Materialize every final survivor. Only K-witnessed local upper bounds may be published.
prediction: May eliminate canonical computations for transient heap candidates. Overlap-heavy equal-distance and overflow data can be slower, including at small K. Extra heap bookkeeping and integer materialization may erase any gain.
unchanged: Canonical final values and signed primary-key ties
Filtered, approximate, disk, other dimensions and larger K use the preceding implementation
native_checks: Independent ExactSum interval/reject checks on every input, per supported float ISA
Directed finite exponent, underflow, overflow, rounding and control-state cases
Single and two-half oracle heaps with multiple schedules and threads
Actual root image, public protocol and existing full regressions
Exact database oracle queries in normal/forced-two modes
microbenchmark: Separate single-thread kernel/heap AB/BA pairs on ordinary, equal-norm, near-tie and overflow data, with canonical counters collected separately. No conversion to database or official score.
performance: Unchanged EE 12-pair screen, then same-host 12-pair ablation against parent runtime. Retain all adverse samples. Original primary gates remain unchanged. Passing initial screening is insufficient without R guards and independent confirmation.
